_notice: REAL posts, discovered via public web search (no authenticated social API is connected — see README > Connecting Live Data). Two honest limitations: (1) engagement metrics (likes/comments/shares) are not visible in search results without platform API access, so metricsAvailable is false and the UI shows that instead of a number — nothing here is an invented metric; (2) most results are Mintoak's own official channel posts, because public search indexes very little third-party chatter about a B2B merchant-payments platform (X/Twitter in particular barely indexes individual posts, and no Reddit mentions were found at all as of the discoveryDate below). Where the exact publish date wasn't visible in search results, dateConfidence is 'discovered' and publishedDate is null — the post is placed on the timeline by discoveryDate instead of a guessed date.
